images.finding: Millennium departure keeps the plaza, Cloud Gate, Pavilion and Loop facades in frame. This first history-reset frame is visibly grainier than later samples; no structural occlusion.
Beach house, sand, groynes, road and lakefront neighborhood connect into a smooth hazy horizon. No large water/terrain gap; broad park surfaces remain simplified.
St Michael roof, clock and spire are visible within the surrounding street grid from the rear/roof axis. No blocking structure; contextual facades repeat.
The Beach House broadside shows blue portholes/trim, white walls, red funnels, railings, furniture and flag with the downtown skyline behind it. No foreground obstruction.

Fisher Bridge has a thin horizontal deck with broad shallow approach ramps, open gaps underneath and railings above. The Cafe roof and parts of its masonry are visible behind the bridge and trees. The previously dominant erroneous tall wall remains absent.
Historic zoo masonry, public paths and seasonal light structures remain legible. A pole/string and tree crown occupy part of the foreground without dominating the whole view.
Conservatory glass-house volumes, fine roof framing and planted beds are visible with Lily Pool/park/lake context. Thin framing has residual sampling softness.

Belmont Harbor and its docks now sit beside continuous green parkland, with the curved access drive and pale promenade separately legible. The mapped woodland belt is selectively planted in the background; harbor/lake water remains distinct. Sparse representative boats and repeated city facades remain simplified.
Wrigley bowl, turf and seats are broadly visible above the roof; the rear of one display occupies the lower foreground. No full-field obstruction.
The endpoint looks across open turf toward ivy, scoreboard, screens and stands. The right screen is cropped by framing; fine ivy/seat detail remains partly undersampled.

Pond, bridge and boardwalk are readable together; open space under the bridge remains visible.
A wider view opens down the boardwalk with reflective pond water on the left. Correctly shallow bridge approaches remain in the background.
